Here's the analysis of the four interrelated issues:

---

## 1. Cartesian Product Batching (line 53) — Validation runs 6× instead of 3×

```xml
<Message Text="Validating %(ProtoFile.Filename) with rule %(ValidationRule.Filename)" />
```

When a single task references `%(ItemA.Meta)` and `%(ItemB.Meta)` from **two different item types**, MSBuild performs **outer/cross-join batching**: 3 protos × 2 rules = **6 executions**. To validate each proto against all rules sequentially (3 runs), you'd need target-level batching on `ProtoFile` and expand `@(ValidationRule)` non-batched inside, or vice versa.

---

## 2. CS2002 Duplicate Source Warnings (lines 16–19 vs SDK default + line 36)

Three sources of the same files in `Compile`:

| Source | Mechanism |
|--------|-----------|
| SDK default glob | `**/*.cs` auto-includes all `.cs` (including `.g.cs`) files on disk |
| Line 16 | Explicit `<Compile Include="**\*.g.cs">` — duplicates anything the SDK already found |
| Line 36 (inside target) | `<Compile Include="$(IntermediateOutputPath)%(ProtoFile.Filename).g.cs" />` — adds a third entry when the target runs |

The line 16 glob is entirely redundant with the SDK default. It should use `<Compile Update="**\*.g.cs">` to set metadata on already-included items without re-including them.

---

## 3. Clean Removes Too Many Files (line 60)

```xml
<Compile Remove="**\*.g.cs" />
```

This removes **all** `.g.cs` files from compilation — not just the generated ones. Any hand-written file following the `.g.cs` convention would be silently dropped from the build after clean. Additionally, the static `FileWrites` ItemGroup (line 42) is evaluated at project load regardless of whether GenerateProtoCode ran, so Clean may attempt to delete files that weren't produced in the current build.

---

## 4. Generated Files Not Tracked Across Incremental Builds (line 36)

The `<Compile Include>` inside `GenerateProtoCode` only executes **when the target runs**. On incremental builds (inputs older than outputs), the target is skipped and those files are never added to `Compile`. The static glob on line 16 was likely added to compensate, but it creates the duplicate problem above and only works if the files already exist on disk at evaluation time (not on a fresh clone/first build from a different intermediate path).

The correct pattern is:

- Use `<Compile Update>` (not `Include`) in the static ItemGroup for metadata only
- Add generated outputs to `Compile` in a **separate target** that always runs (no `Inputs`/`Outputs` skip logic), or use `<Compile Include>` in the static ItemGroup with a condition/transform from `ProtoFile`

---

## Root Cause Summary

| Symptom | Root Cause |
|---------|-----------|
| 6 validation runs | Cross-item-type `%()` batching = cartesian product |
| CS2002 warnings | SDK default glob + explicit `Include` + target `Include` = triple registration |
| Clean too aggressive | Wildcard `Remove` hits all `.g.cs`, not just generated ones |
| Tracking gaps | `Compile Include` inside incremental target is skipped when up-to-date |
